name: oni-game
description: リアル鬼ごっこ（鬼ごっこ＋ミッション＋情報戦）スマホ向けWebアプリ

scripts.test:emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database,functions --project demo-oni-game "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests-emulator/*.test.js"
scripts.emulators: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,database,functions --project demo-oni-game
